values.note: Every RV site (40-43, 46-48, 54-60) $40 a night plus tax on the county's Amilia store; tent sites $25 (double $35). A tent on an RV site costs extra, paid at the office.

fees.source: https://app.amilia.com/store/en/monongalia-county-parks--recreation/shop/facilitybookings (14 'RV Site NN at Chestnut Ridge Park' items, each $40.00/night; tent sites $25.00/night) + /facilitybookings/1117475 ('RV Site 40 (max. length 40') – Area D- $40 (plus tax) per night'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://app.amilia.com/store/en/monongalia-county-parks--recreation/shop/facilitybookings/1117475 ('Each RV site at Chestnut Ridge Park is equipped with: 30 amp electric, Water hookup ...'; 'There is no sewage hookup on any of the sites, but you are welcome to use the dump station near RV Area E'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 14 RV sites in Areas D and E plus 30-odd primitive tent sites and seven cabins. Area D 'is for our guests who have larger RVs' (site 40: max. length 40 ft). Gravel pads, some leveling needed, all back-in.

sites.source: https://www.monongaliacounty.gov/departments/parks_and_recreation/chestnut_ridge_park_and_campground/ ('We offer more than 30 primitive tent sites, 14 RV sites, and seven unique cabins') + Amilia RV Site 40 ('max. length 40'', 'RV Area D is for our guests who have larger RVs', 'All RV pads are gravel, some leveling will be required, and all sites are back in only'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: Amilia RV Site 40 ('the dump station near RV Area E'; 'Firewood is available for purchase at the park store'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book each RV site online on the county's Amilia store or by phone, (304) 594-1773, office 9 a.m.-5 p.m. daily. RV sites may not be reserved for tents. Check-in 2 p.m. at the park office (late arrivals check in by 9:30 next morning), checkout before noon.

booking.source: Amilia RV Site 40 ('Please call (304) 594-1773 for more information or to make a reservation over the phone. Our office hours are 9AM-5PM daily.'; 'Camping check-in time is 2:00PM and check out time is before noon'; Book / Reserve form) + county page ('Online Reservations' link), read 2026-10-21

note: Ridge-top park near Morgantown; no significant water bodies at the campground. --Claude
summary: Fees $40 confirmed (plus tax; Amilia store); added hookups 30A/water/no sewer, 14 back-in RV sites to 40 ft, dump and park store, booking (Amilia online or phone). Season not stated for the campground. Note: dropped a stray campingprepper.com listicle URL.
